title: copy_assets
description: Canonical memory schema for Agent 4.1 (Copy + Prompt Engine) output. The OUTPUT-1 payload is an OBJECT wrapping the produced copy assets so base.py object-routing (write_memory_block) works. Each asset carries client-facing ES-MX copy (hook/caption/cta/variants/hashtags), the fal.ai image-generation prompts (flux-2-pro / ideogram-3.0) for Agent 4.2, and a risk_tier driving the risk-tiered human gate. Read by Layers 5 (distribution) and 6 (analytics). | Depends on: DEL-26 (system prompt), content_plan/content_calendar (L3), audience_segments (1.2), competitive_map (1.3), client_profile (DEL-17). | First authored: 2026-05-29

text.description: Alternative hook/short caption for A/B testing. Client-facing — Español (MX).

angle.description: English. One-line test hypothesis for this variant.

model_target.description: Target fal.ai image model. flux-2-pro = photoreal/brand hero; ideogram-3.0 = legible in-image text required.

prompt.description: English positive prompt: subject, composition, lighting, style, color guidance, aspect-ratio guidance.

negative_prompt.description: English. What to avoid (text, competitor logos, watermarks, distortions, brand-safety violations).

in_image_text.description: Literal text to render in-image, Español (MX), <= 8 words. Only with ideogram-3.0; null for flux-2-pro.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio matched to the channel/format.

content_item_ref.description: Pointer to the briefed content-plan item (topic slug or campaign+week) this copy was produced for.

language.description: BCP-47-ish tag for the client-facing copy, e.g. es-MX, es-CO.

hook.description: Scroll-stopping opening line. Español (MX). Leads with pain/payoff, not the brand name.

primary_caption.description: Main body copy, sized to channel/format. Español (MX), ROI-grounded, on-brand.

char_count.description: Character length of primary_caption for platform-limit sanity checks.

cta.description: Call to action, Español (MX), sized to the funnel stage.

hashtags.description: 0-8 ES-MX hashtags; empty for non-social channels.

image_prompts.description: Image-gen prompts for Agent 4.2; empty array for text-only formats.

risk_tier.description: low = routine, auto-approve-eligible; medium = needs review; high = always human review (claims/competitor/regulated/constraint conflict).

risk_reason.description: English. One-line justification for the assigned risk_tier.

rationale.description: English. Why this copy/angle for this item + segment.

notes.description: English. Localization calls, constraint handling, fill-ins for the operator.

assets_needing_review.description: Count of assets with risk_tier medium or high.

client_id.description: Client this copy set belongs to. Lowercase-hyphenated. Example: acme-co.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this copy_assets block was produced.

gate_status.description: Risk-tiered rollup. auto_approved when all assets are low-risk; pending_review when any medium/high or a constraint conflict; blocked when no items/missing required input.

cycle_month.description: Cycle this copy serves, format YYYY-MM, or null.

markets.description: Markets the copy targets, e.g. Mexico, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Puerto Rico.

source_plan.description: Id/ref of the content_plan or content_calendar this copy was produced from.

assets.description: Produced copy assets. Empty array on the blocked path (missing required input / no items).

production_notes.description: English. Choices, constraint handling, localization, and any blocks.
